description: Use when the user asks for formal verification or formal methods: writing or checking a design model (TLA+, Alloy, P, Quint), proving code against contracts (Dafny, Verus, SPARK, Frama-C, Lean, Rocq), model checking, invariants, liveness, vacuous passes, or counterexamples; deciding whether a design or requirement warrants formal verification; or keeping existing formal specs and proofs current. Not for prose requirements or "spec this out" (use sdd).
